added_lines: béal an phobail we intend to begin a conversation circle in evelyn’s central bar, carrick beginning 5/11/26 from 7-8pm. this is not an irish class, it will be a place/space to practice & develop your spoken irish and lift your confidence in using your irish socially. it doesn't matter if you are fluent or a learner. beidh fearadh na fáilte romhat! kilcar
